what: Real /archive-mail runs against Apple Mail in scratch copies of one existing workspace (config, index, threads, archived md). Mail was only read; the real workspace was not modified. Addresses are replaced by placeholders (P1, P2 = two sender addresses; G = the maintainer's own address).
